reasons.claim: Notified regeneration felling, 0.56 ha polygon in Torsby. Completed felling from 2018 overlaps 26% (0.145 ha), below the 50% threshold, so the site is not ALREADY_FELLED.

One eligible species within 250 m: VU lichen Alectoria sarmentosa (site-bound, forest-associated). Its listed threats include lack of continuity forest, lack of large/old trees and changed stand structure. There are 2 records, both from 2019, at 153 m and 234 m, with 10 m uncertainty.
Effort is above the county median (92 records vs 20.5; 88th percentile). Within 250 m there are 2 records of 1 species and none inside the polygon.

contradictions.claim: The part of the polygon already felled in 2018 may no longer hold the habitat. The 2019 lichen records postdate that felling but lie outside the polygon, so which stand they were in is unknown.

uncertainties: Both records are from a single day in 2019, so the lichen's present occurrence is unknown.
Records are 153 m and 234 m away. The lichen may not grow in the notified stand.
The 26% overlap covers a polygon of only 0.56 ha, so the remaining area is smaller than notified.
not_established: Whether the lichen occurs inside the polygon.
That the site is safe to fell.
Absence of other records does not show absence of other species.
next_action: Reviewer should check the two 2019 Alectoria sarmentosa record locations against the polygon and the 2018 felling. They should also judge whether the unfelled remainder has similar old-forest features.
